name: Abhinav Ohri
tagline: Building cool stuff. Shipping fast. Breaking things (on purpose).
description: Passionate developer with experience in building modern web applications. I love creating elegant solutions to complex problems and continuously learning new technologies.

highlights: CreateOS: Delivered accounting and expense-management capabilities across React, TypeScript, and FastAPI, including batch imports, approval workflows, budget allocation, Tipalti vendor integration, and externally paid expenses; integrated human-reviewed LLM invoice extraction with reconciliation and financial-validation safeguards into the submission workflow.

A&R Dashboard: Built a music analytics dashboard over 2M streaming records, reducing ingestion time from 30 minutes to under 5 minutes, completing core artist, track, and group scoring in under 10 seconds, and serving materialized analytical views in under 10 ms. Enabled users to explore the underlying music data through an AI chat interface that returned data-backed answers and tabular results, and deployed the platform on GCP.

HR Bot: Developed an AI-assisted technical-sourcing platform that discovers, enriches, and ranks candidates using GitHub, web, CV, and LinkedIn evidence; deployed asynchronous FastAPI pipelines on GKE with PostgreSQL, Redis, WebSockets, and Kubernetes Jobs and CronJobs.

Flutter & Node.js Platform: Built and scaled an event-reservation platform to over 10,000 users and 1.6K monthly active users, owning end-to-end development across Flutter applications for iOS and Android and Node.js and MongoDB services for booking, multi-ticket checkout, payments, real-time messaging, host analytics, and brand collaboration.

Mobile Performance & Cloud Infrastructure: Optimized application performance through paginated loading, shared client caching, consolidated API requests, and dimension-aware WebP delivery using AWS CloudFront and CloudFormation; managed production deployments, environment segregation, monitoring, and incident debugging across the platform.
GrandForum: Enhanced a MediaWiki-based collaboration tool used for project coordination and document submissions
Implemented end-to-end features including reviewer assignment, comment history, and file upload handling using PHP for backend logic
Simplified multi-step workflows using Backbone.js for state management and vanilla JS for role-specific behaviors
Delivered CSS improvements, persistent UI configurations, and layout changes that resolved client-reported usability issues
Liquidation Protocol Efficiency Tracker: Engineered a full-stack liquidation monitoring system
Utilized Ponder to index on-chain events and a Flask backend to compute real-time efficiency metrics
Developed a RESTful API to serve processed data to a React and Material UI dashboard
Visualized latency between positions becoming liquidatable and actual liquidation transactions
DTI Reviewer: Built an author ranking system coupling Flask backend for cosine-similarity analysis with responsive React UI
PACManWeb: Created peer-review support tool with scalable React interface using Context API + useReducer for state management
Implemented real-time log streaming via SSE, React-Bootstrap UI components, and tested using React Testing Library + Vitest
Delivered smooth reviewer workflows with component-level and browser-storage caching and lazy-loaded routes
Tardis: Mentored students in scientific software development focusing on visualization techniques and regression testing
Guided on software design and documentation best practices
Strengthened students' technical and professional skills
Improved reliability, usability, and long-term sustainability of the TARDIS research codebase
